text:
aisha (product): Quick sync: adaptive-capacity routing pilot next week. Need a concise GA criteria checklist we can publish after pilot: SLA language, billing mode, runbook link, monitoring panels, and customer-facing expectations. Can folks claim owners?

trent (eng): I'll take SLA strings and metric names. Proposing: public availability SLA = 99.9% (routing control plane), pilot-internal perf SLO = p99 < 430ms. Agree?

rachel (pricing): For billing we want opt-in billing with a surcharge multiplier. Suggest 1.5x for pilot, but can discuss. Need a billing preview UI copy.

kai (sre): Runbook + alerts: I can author. Pager thresholds: p99 > 700ms for 5m OR error_rate > 3% for 5m -> pager. Lower sev -> ticket. Will add synthetic checks.

omar (docs): I'll produce the short expectations doc + FAQ. I need exact SLA sentence and billing sample rows to embed.

nina (support): Support playbook: immediate workaround = disable opt-in for customer via Console; escalate to eng after 10m if >3 customers or >2% error delta for 10m. I'll draft canned replies.

infra-bot: Deployment job queued: deploy/adaptive-capacity/2026-pilot (ETA 02:00 PT).

trent (eng): Technical note: fallback behavior will route to a quantized variant when queue depth > threshold or latency alerts fire. We'll document quality trade-offs. Metric names: routing.fallback_engaged_count, routing.queue_depth_p50/p95/p99.

aisha (product): For public wording, keep it simple: "We maintain availability; during exceptional load we may route to a lower-capacity model to preserve service. Output may vary slightly." Omar, use that line?

omar (docs): Copy accepted. I'll include a sample invoice line: "Adaptive Capacity Surcharge (opt-in)  1.5x tokens routed during surge windows" and a sample calculation row. Will send to rachel for review.

rachel (pricing): Review note: change multiplier to "1.5x (pilot)" in the UI and include a hover tooltip: "pilot pricing subject to change". Also request estimated monthly delta be shown before enabling.

trent (eng): Implementation config snippet for ops repo: ```yaml
routing:
  adaptive_capacity:
    opt_in_default: false
    surcharge_multiplier: 1.5
```

kai (sre): Runbook skeleton: detect -> auto-throttle -> switch-to-fallback -> notify-oncall -> rollback or mitigate. I'll link dashboards: latency-by-region, fallback-rate, billing-estimate.

nina (support): I'll add step-by-step: how to verify a customer's routing state in Console and how to preview billing impact. Will sync with Omar's doc.

aisha (product): Owners recap: SLA & metrics -> trent; runbook & alerts -> kai; billing copy + UI text -> rachel; user docs + FAQ -> omar; support templates -> nina. Publish checklist when pilot data looks stable.

trent (eng): Action: post staging p50/p95/p99 numbers and sample fallback quality diffs by EOD.

omar (docs): I'll drop a draft link in #product-docs and tag pricing for the invoice line check.

kai (sre): I'll open runbook PR and create a dashboard tile for "adaptive-capacity impact".

rachel (pricing): Will prepare UI copy and a small FAQ blurb: "Why you're charged" + "How to opt-out".

aisha (product): Decision: default opt-in = OFF for pilot. Customers must enable explicitly. Final check tomorrow 11:00 PT. Any last-minute objections?

trent (eng): No objections. One ask: product confirm whether we include a short SLA clause about fallbacks (so legal can review).

aisha (product): Add: "Fallbacks are operational measures and not covered by the latency SLO; availability promise remains." Omar, add to docs and cc legal.

omar (docs): Will include and cc legal. Draft out in 2 hours.

(ended thread)
